items.title: 〈財報〉川普媒體Q2巨虧2.38億美元！營收雖增89% 仍難敵加密資產暴跌
items.title_en: <Financial Report> Trump Media Q2 Losses $238.1 Million; Revenue Up 89% Yet Still Can't Offset Crypto Crash
paras: 川普旗下媒體公司 Trump Media & Technology Group(TMTG) (DJT-US) 周一 (10 日) 公布 2026 年第 2 季財報，受數位資產及股票投資價值下跌拖累，單季淨損擴大至 2.381 億美元，遠高於去年同期約 2000 萬美元虧損；營收則僅 170 萬美元，雖年增 89%, 但與巨額虧損相比仍顯得微不足道。
TMTG 表示，截至 6 月 30 日止第 2 季，淨損主要來自非現金資產價值下降，其中數位資產、質押數位資產及股權證券相關損失合計約 1.904 億美元。此外，公司還認列約 1170 萬美元的利息累增及 810 萬美元的股票薪酬等費用。
公司第 2 季調整後 EBITDA 虧損也達 2.235 億美元，顯示即使排除部分非現金項目的影響，核心營運仍處於大幅虧損狀態。TMTG 同時表示，截至第 2 季末，公司總資產約 20 億美元，其中金融資產約 19 億美元，包括現金、受限制現金、短期投資、股權證券、應收票據及利息、數位資產及質押數位資產等。
營收方面，TMTG 第 2 季營收約 170 萬美元，較去年同期約 90 萬美元增加 89%。絕大部分收入來自旗下社群平台 Truth Social 的廣告服務，顯示公司目前仍高度依賴規模有限的媒體業務，而數位資產價格波動對整體財務結果的影響遠大於傳統廣告營收。
TMTG 財務長 Phillip Juhan 在公司首次舉行的財報電話會議中表示，公司營運費用很大程度受到數位資產價格波動影響。第 2 季營運費用超過 1.65 億美元，較去年同期增加約 275%, 進一步擴大公司獲利壓力。
其中，法律支出仍是營運費用的重要來源之一。公司表示，第 2 季用於營運活動的現金約為 1370 萬美元，其中約 2560 萬美元與法律費用有關，主要涉及過去累積的訴訟案件。不過，TMTG 表示，多項歷史法律問題已大致獲得解決，未來法律相關支出可望明顯下降。
TMTG 目前也正試圖降低對加密貨幣業務的依賴。公司近期終止與 Crypto.com 及 Yorkville Acquisition Corp. 相關的多項交易，原先計畫利用 Crypto.com 的 Cronos 區塊鏈及 CRO 代幣建立加密貨幣策略業務。TMTG 目前則將更多資源重新導向 Truth Social 的媒體、資料授權及其他核心業務。
在數位資產價格下跌對財報造成重大衝擊之際，公司正推出新的變現方式，其中最受矚目的是 Truth API。
TMTG 表示，Truth API 已在 8 月 1 日正式推出，主要向機構客戶提供 Truth Social 內容的快速資料串流，讓高頻交易公司及其他金融機構能比一般使用者更快取得平台上的重要貼文。
TMTG 在財報中透露，目前已簽署超過 10 份 Truth API 客戶協議，客戶主要為高頻交易公司。公司證實，相關服務收費約為每月 6 萬至 10 萬美元，長期合約可取得較低價格。
換言之，如果目前超過 10 家客戶均按照最低每月 6 萬美元的價格付費，Truth API 至少已形成每月 60 萬美元以上的潛在經常性收入；若全部按照每月 10 萬美元的價格計算，月收入則可達 100 萬美元以上。不過，公司並未公布每一家客戶的實際合約金額，因此目前不能將上述金額視為已實現營收。
Truth API 的商業模式也引發市場及政治層面的爭議。TMTG 先前宣布，將向銀行、交易公司及其他機構提供 Truth Social 上最具影響力帳號的高速資料，可能包括川普的貼文。由於川普經常透過 Truth Social 發布可能影響金融市場的政策訊息，批評者質疑，這項服務是否會讓付費機構取得其他市場參與者沒有的資訊速度優勢。
TMTG 則主張，Truth API 只是將公開發布於 Truth Social 的內容以更快、更可靠的方式提供給機構客戶，並強調其目標是縮小資料延遲，而非提供未公開資訊。
Truth Social 本身仍面臨流量規模及廣告變現能力的挑戰。近期市場報導指出，Truth Social 的網站及應用程式流量今年夏季明顯下滑，與 X 等大型社群平台相比，整體用戶規模仍相對有限。這使得 TMTG 即使成功提高廣告營收，仍難以單靠傳統社群媒體模式支撐目前的企業規模。
因此，TMTG 目前正嘗試把 Truth Social 從單純的社群平台轉變成多元化數位資產，包括內容串流、資料授權、金融服務及加密貨幣等業務。
其中 Truth + 影音服務目前已進入全面商業化階段，TMTG 也表示 Truth Social 正在擴大內容布局。公司希望藉由增加內容及服務種類，提高平台使用時間及廣告價值，並尋找除了廣告之外的收入來源。
TMTG 的另一項重大戰略則是與核融合能源公司 TAE Technologies 的合併。雙方去年 12 月宣布達成一項全股票交易，交易估值超過 60 億美元，合併後雙方股東在完全稀釋基礎上預計各持有約 50% 的合併公司股份。合併交易被 TMTG 視為未來長期股東價值的重要來源。
TMTG 與 TAE Technologies 今年 6 月表示，雙方仍以盡快完成合併為目標，預計最晚在 2026 年第 4 季或更早完成交易。雙方同時放棄原先將 Truth Social 等媒體資產分拆成獨立上市公司的計畫。
這項策略轉變顯示，TMTG 目前並不打算將 Truth Social 單獨拆分，而是希望將媒體平台與 TAE 的核融合能源技術整合，打造涵蓋媒體、科技及能源的企業架構。
TMTG 臨時執行長 Kevin McGurn 表示，公司目前正逐步集中資源於成長計畫，並認為與 TAE Technologies 的合併是推動長期股東價值最重要的因素之一。公司同時希望透過 Truth+、Truth Social 及 Truth API 等業務改善營收結構。
不過，對投資人而言，TMTG 最大的問題仍是營收與估值之間的巨大落差。第 2 季營收僅 170 萬美元，卻出現 2.381 億美元淨損，意味著公司目前的資產價值、加密貨幣投資及未來商業計畫，對整體企業估值的影響遠高於現有媒體業務產生的現金流。
這種財務結構也使 TMTG 的季度獲利容易受到金融市場波動影響。公司第 2 季大部分虧損來自數位資產及股票等金融資產的未實現價值變動，當相關資產價格上升時可能推升帳面價值，但價格下跌時也會迅速放大淨損。
在此之前，TMTG 在 2025 年全年已錄得約 7.123 億美元虧損，當時數位資產價值變動同樣是造成巨額損失的重要因素。近期公司縮減部分加密貨幣計畫，也反映管理層正在重新評估這類業務對企業財務穩定性的影響。
另一方面，川普仍是 TMTG 最具影響力的資產之一。川普透過信託持有公司大量股份，市場也長期將 DJT 股價視為與川普政治影響力及個人品牌高度相關的特殊標的，而非單純依照傳統媒體公司的營收及獲利能力估值。
隨著川普目前仍擔任美國總統，Truth Social 上的政治及政策訊息具備較高市場關注度，這也成為 TMTG 推出 Truth API 的重要商業基礎。但隨著美國總統任期未來走向及平台使用率變化，市場仍將觀察這項特殊流量優勢能否轉化為持久的商業價值。
目前 TMTG 正處於轉型關鍵期。一方面，公司必須降低加密貨幣價格波動對財務報表造成的巨大影響；另一方面，又必須證明 Truth Social、Truth + 及 Truth API 能夠真正建立可持續的營收來源。
如果 Truth API 能持續吸引高頻交易及金融機構客戶，將有機會成為 TMTG 目前規模仍小的廣告業務之外，另一個高毛利收入來源；但若 Truth Social 流量持續下滑，或 Truth API 無法擴大客戶數量，公司仍將面臨核心業務營收不足的問題。
在 TAE Technologies 合併預計於今年第 4 季或更早完成的情況下，TMTG 未來也將逐步從一家以 Truth Social 為核心的政治媒體公司，轉向同時布局媒體、金融科技及核融合能源的複合型企業。這項轉型能否提升企業實際營收及現金流，將成為投資人接下來評估 DJT 的重要關鍵。
paras_en: Trump Media & Technology Group (TMTG) (DJT-US) released its 2026 second‑quarter results on Monday (the 10th). Dragged down by declines in digital‑asset and equity‑investment values, the quarterly net loss widened to $238.1 million, far above the roughly $20 million loss a year earlier; revenue was only $1.7 million, up 89% year‑over‑year but still negligible compared with the massive loss.

TMTG said that as of June 30, the net loss was mainly due to the fall in non‑cash asset values, with losses on digital assets, pledged digital assets and equity securities totaling about $190.4 million. In addition, the company recorded roughly $11.7 million of accrued interest and $8.1 million of stock‑based compensation expenses.

Adjusted EBITDA for the quarter was a loss of $223.5 million, showing that even after stripping out some non‑cash items, core operations remain deeply loss‑making. TMTG also noted that total assets at quarter‑end were about $2 billion, of which roughly $1.9 billion were financial assets, including cash, restricted cash, short‑term investments, equity securities, notes and interest receivable, digital assets and pledged digital assets.

Revenue for the quarter was about $1.7 million, up from roughly $900,000 a year earlier, an 89% increase. Almost all of the revenue came from advertising on its social platform Truth Social, indicating the company is still heavily reliant on a relatively small media business, while the impact of digital‑asset price swings on overall financial results dwarfs traditional ad revenue.

Chief Financial Officer Phillip Juhan told participants in the company’s first earnings call that operating expenses were heavily affected by digital‑asset price volatility. Operating expenses exceeded $165 million in the quarter, about 275% higher than a year ago, further squeezing profitability.

Legal costs remained a major component of operating expenses. The company said cash used for operating activities was about $13.7 million, of which roughly $25.6 million related to legal fees tied to past lawsuits. TMTG added that many historic legal issues have largely been resolved and future legal spending should fall markedly.

TMTG is also working to reduce its reliance on crypto‑related business. It recently terminated several deals with Crypto.com and Yorkville Acquisition Corp. that had been intended to build a crypto‑strategy using Crypto.com’s Cronos blockchain and CRO token. The firm is now redirecting resources toward Truth Social’s media, data‑licensing and other core operations.
Amid the sharp hit to the financials from falling digital‑asset prices, the company is rolling out new monetisation methods, the most notable being the Truth API.

TMTG said the Truth API launched on August 1, offering institutional clients fast data streams of Truth Social content so high‑frequency trading firms and other financial institutions can access key posts more quickly than ordinary users.

The filing disclosed that more than ten Truth API customer agreements have been signed, primarily with high‑frequency trading firms. The service is priced at roughly $60,000‑$100,000 per month, with lower rates available under longer‑term contracts.

In other words, if the ten‑plus customers each paid the minimum $60,000 per month, the API would generate at least $600,000 of potential recurring revenue; at the top end of $100,000 per month, monthly revenue could exceed $1 million. The company did not disclose individual contract values, so these figures cannot be treated as realised revenue.

The Truth API business model has sparked debate in both market and political circles. TMTG previously announced it would provide banks, trading firms and other institutions with high‑speed data on the most influential Truth Social accounts, potentially including posts by Trump. Critics argue the service could give paying firms an informational speed advantage unavailable to other market participants, especially since Trump often uses Truth Social to release policy signals that could move markets.

TMTG counters that the Truth API simply delivers publicly posted Truth Social content faster and more reliably to institutional clients, emphasizing that its purpose is to reduce data latency, not to supply non‑public information.

Truth Social itself still faces challenges in traffic volume and ad‑monetisation. Recent market reports note a clear dip in website and app traffic this summer, and the platform’s user base remains modest compared with larger networks such as X, making it difficult for TMTG to sustain its current scale solely on traditional social‑media advertising.

Consequently, TMTG is trying to evolve Truth Social from a pure social platform into a diversified digital‑asset business that includes content streaming, data licensing, financial services and crypto‑related activities.

The Truth + video service has entered full commercialisation, and TMTG says Truth Social is expanding its content portfolio. The firm hopes that by adding more content and service types it can increase user‑time, boost ad value and create revenue streams beyond advertising.

Another major strategic move for TMTG is its planned merger with fusion‑energy company TAE Technologies. The two announced in December last year a all‑stock transaction valued at over $6 billion, with each side expected to own roughly 50% of the combined company on a fully diluted basis. TMTG views the merger as a key source of long‑term shareholder value.

In June this year, TMTG and TAE reiterated their goal of completing the merger as soon as possible, targeting the fourth quarter of 2026 or earlier, and both parties have abandoned the earlier plan to spin off Truth Social and other media assets into a separate public company.

This strategic shift shows TMTG does not intend to split off Truth Social but rather to integrate the media platform with TAE’s fusion‑energy technology, creating a corporate structure that spans media, technology and energy.

Interim CEO Kevin McGurn said the company is gradually concentrating resources on growth initiatives and believes the merger with TAE Technologies is one of the most important drivers of long‑term shareholder value. He added that the firm hopes to improve its revenue mix through Truth +, Truth Social and the Truth API.

Nevertheless, investors’ biggest concern remains the huge gap between revenue and valuation. With only $1.7 million of revenue in Q2 against a $238.1 million net loss, the company’s asset base, crypto holdings and future business plans weigh far more on its valuation than the cash flow generated by its existing media operations.

This financial structure also makes TMTG’s quarterly profitability highly sensitive to market swings. Most of the Q2 loss stemmed from unrealised value changes in digital assets and equity securities; when those prices rise, book value improves, but declines quickly amplify the net loss.

Earlier, TMTG posted a full‑year loss of about $712.3 million in 2025, also driven largely by digital‑asset valuation swings. Recent cuts to some crypto initiatives reflect management’s reassessment of how such activities affect the firm’s financial stability.

On the other hand, Trump remains one of TMTG’s most valuable assets. He holds a large block of shares through a trust, and the market has long priced DJT stock as a special vehicle tied closely to his political influence and personal brand rather than traditional media earnings and profitability metrics.

With Trump still in office, political and policy messages on Truth Social attract heightened market attention, providing a key commercial rationale for the Truth API. However, as the presidential term evolves and platform usage changes, the market will watch whether this unique traffic advantage can translate into lasting commercial value.

TMTG is at a pivotal transformation point. It must both curb the impact of crypto‑price volatility on its statements and demonstrate that Truth Social, Truth + and the Truth API can generate sustainable revenue streams.

If the Truth API continues to attract high‑frequency traders and financial institutions, it could become a high‑margin revenue source beyond the still‑small advertising business. Conversely, if Truth Social traffic keeps falling or the API fails to grow its client base, the firm will still face a shortfall in core‑business revenue.

Assuming the TAE Technologies merger is completed in the fourth quarter of this year or sooner, TMTG will gradually shift from a Trump‑centric political‑media company to a diversified enterprise that spans media, fintech and fusion energy. Whether this transformation can lift actual revenue and cash flow will be a key factor investors consider when evaluating DJT going forward.

items.title: 川普否認頻繁熱線華許 強調「只有短暫一次」
items.title_en: Trump Denies Frequent Calls to Powell, Stresses 'Just One Time'
paras: 美國總統川普週一 (10 日) 證實，近日曾與聯準會主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 短暫通話，但否認兩人自華許上任後頻繁聯繫，試圖淡化外界對白宮干預貨幣政策及聯準會獨立性的疑慮。
《華爾街日報》日前報導，華許今年 5 月接掌聯準會後，已與川普多次交談。川普反駁報導內容，表示兩人只在幾天前短暫談過一次，並非外界所稱的經常通話。
川普說：「他們講得好像我一直和華許通話，但我只跟他談過一次。」
聯準會尚未回應相關報導。
華許先前表示，願意聽取總統或任何人士對利率政策的看法，但最終仍會根據自己的判斷決定政策方向。川普則持續公開要求華許降息，但也承認利率決策並非由主席一人決定。
川普週一表示，如果完全由華許決定，結果可能會不同，「但他還有一個委員會」。聯準會利率政策由聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 集體表決，主席無法單方面決定利率走向。
美國總統與聯準會主席直接接觸，近年相對罕見。川普 2025 年重返白宮後，與前主席鮑爾僅舉行過一次定期正式會議。兩人之後也曾一同視察聯準會總部翻修工程，當時川普指控鮑爾管理工程不當。
除了公開施壓降息，川普上週還重新推動撤換聯準會理事庫克 (Lisa Cook)。庫克在聯準會理事會的任期長達 14 年，目前尚不清楚川普與華許的通話，是發生在川普再次要求撤換庫克之前或之後。
這起通話也讓聯準會獨立性再度成為市場焦點。美國國會授權聯準會在不受政治因素左右的情況下制定利率政策。
歷史上，1970 年代聯準會主席伯恩斯 (Arthur Burns) 與時任總統尼克森關係過於密切，之後美國爆發嚴重通膨，成為政治干預貨幣政策風險的典型案例。
另一方面，華許公布的 6 月行程顯示，他當月曾三度與美國財長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 會面，延續聯準會主席與財長定期共進早餐、交換意見的長期慣例。
paras_en: US President Trump confirmed on Monday (10th) that he had a brief phone call with Federal Reserve Chairman Powell recently, but denied frequent contacts between the two since Powell took office, trying to downplay concerns about White House interference in monetary policy and the independence of the Federal Reserve.

The Wall Street Journal reported earlier that Powell had spoken to Trump multiple times since taking over the Federal Reserve in May. Trump denied the report, saying that the two only spoke briefly a few days ago, not as frequently as reported by the outside world.
Trump said, 'They're saying I'm talking to Powell all the time, but I only talked to him once.'
The Federal Reserve has not responded to the report.

Powell previously stated that he was willing to listen to the President or anyone else's views on interest rate policy, but ultimately would decide policy direction based on his own judgment. Trump has continued to publicly ask Powell to cut interest rates, but also acknowledged that rate decisions are not made by the chairman alone.

Trump said on Monday that if Powell were to decide completely on his own, the result might be different, 'but he has a committee.' The Federal Reserve's interest rate policy is decided by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), and the chairman cannot make decisions on interest rate direction alone.

US President Trump's direct contact with the Federal Reserve Chairman is relatively rare in recent years. After Trump returned to the White House in 2025, he only held one regular formal meeting with former Chairman Powell. The two later inspected the renovation of the Federal Reserve headquarters together, during which Trump accused Powell of mismanaging the project.

In addition to publicly pressuring Powell to cut interest rates, Trump also re-launched an effort to replace Federal Reserve Governor Cook last week. Cook has served on the Federal Reserve Board for 14 years, and it is unclear whether Trump's call to Powell occurred before or after his second request to replace Cook.

This phone call has once again brought the independence of the Federal Reserve into focus. The US Congress has authorized the Federal Reserve to set interest rates without being influenced by political factors.

Historically, in the 1970s, Federal Reserve Chairman Burns had a too-close relationship with then-President Nixon, which led to severe inflation in the US, becoming a classic case of the risk of political interference in monetary policy.

On the other hand, Powell's 6 June schedule shows that he met with US Treasury Secretary Bessent three times that month, continuing the long-standing practice of Federal Reserve Chairman and Treasury Secretary having regular breakfast meetings and exchanging views.

items.title: AI支出熱潮尚未推升企業利潤率！至少目前還沒
items.title_en: AI Spending Surge Has Not Yet Boosted Corporate Profit Margins—At Least Not So Far
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，AI 革命原本應該改善各行各業企業的財務表現。AI 應能幫助企業降低成本、提高效率，進而推升利潤率。然而，到目前為止，情況並未如此發展。
Apollo 首席經濟學家 Torsten Sløk 近期在一份報告中指出，自 2022 年底 OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT 以來，科技與通訊服務業的淨利潤率有所上升。但醫療保健、必需消費品、能源及原材料等眾多其他產業的利潤率，在同期不是持平，就是下滑。
換句話說，輝達 (NVDA-US) 以及「美股七巨頭」中的超大規模雲端服務商，正受惠於龐大的 AI 支出。但標普 500 指數中所謂的「其他 493 家公司」還沒有受惠。至少目前還沒有。
Sløk 寫道：「AI 資本支出熱潮目前只反映在賣方的利潤率，而不是買方的利潤率。這一點很重要，因為標普 493 家公司需要越長時間才能產生投資報酬，對一個如此集中於 AI 交易的經濟體與市場而言，下行風險就越大。」
根據 Sløk 的數據，「美股七巨頭」的淨利潤率目前約為 25%，高於 2023 年底約 15% 的水準；相比之下，標普 500 指數中所謂的「其他 493 家公司」淨利潤率約為 10%。過去三年，「其他 493 家公司」的利潤率大致維持穩定。
Sløk 表示，他最終預期科技及電信服務業以外的產業，利潤率也會擴大，「但這件事發生的速度對市場而言至關重要。」
Sløk 在 7 月初的另一份報告中寫道，許多投資人預期，到 2028 年 AI 支出將帶來實質效益。因此，未來兩年市場需要看到所謂的「實際成果」。
Sløk 表示：「如此多的事情繫於少數幾家公司，如果回報速度較慢，不僅會成為單一產業的問題，還可能使經濟陷入衰退，並導致標普 500 指數出現修正。」
主要股價指數目前都處於或接近歷史高點，很大一部分原因是 AI 樂觀情緒帶動股市上漲。因此，對 ChatGPT、Anthropic 的 Claude 及其他大型語言模型的採用企業而言，關鍵在於向投資人證明，它們投入 AI 的資金將對獲利產生明確且正面的影響。
MFS Investment Management 全球投資策略師 Rob Almeida 表示，「這輪行情取決於 AI 能否按照市場預期的速度實現商業化。」他補充說，鑑於過去幾年的多頭行情，「投資人需要保持謹慎並深思熟慮，但他們通常不會如此」，而且「大量散戶資金正處於風險偏好模式」。
這並不是說 AI 是一個即將破裂的泡沫。但零售、金融服務及醫療保健等非科技產業的企業，可能還需要更多時間，才能真正從 AI 支出中獲得回報。
基於此，Franklin Equity Group 投資組合經理 Jonathan Curtis 表示，投資人可能應該把主要注意力放在那些協助「運行 AI」的公司，也就是超大規模雲端服務商。
Curtis 表示：「你開始看到投資人重新放心地回到『美股七巨頭』這個避風港。」
Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF 持有輝達、蘋果 (AAPL-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、Meta Platforms(META-US) 及特斯拉(TSLA-US)，今年 8 月至今上漲近 5%。大型科技股交易的重新升溫，也推動標普 500 指數本月迄今上漲 3.5%。
目前而言，這沒有問題，因為投資人正在為科技業強勁的財報表現喝采。但 AI 支出必須產生實際成果——尤其目前標普 500 指數的本益比約為今年預估盈餘的 22 倍。
如果所有這些向超大規模雲端服務商開出巨額 AI 支票的企業，其利潤率沒有開始出現實質改善，這將讓大盤進一步上漲變得更加難以合理化。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reports that the AI revolution was expected to improve the financial performance of companies across industries. AI should help firms cut costs and boost efficiency, thereby raising profit margins. However, so far this has not materialized.

Apollo chief economist Torsten Sløk recently noted in a report that since OpenAI launched ChatGPT at the end of 2022, net profit margins have risen in the technology and communications services sectors. By contrast, margins in many other industries—including healthcare, consumer staples, energy and raw materials—have either held steady or fallen over the same period.

In other words, Nvidia (NVDA-US) and the ultra‑large cloud service providers among the U.S. ‘Magnificent Seven’ are benefiting from massive AI spending. The so‑called “other 493 companies” in the S&P 500 have not yet seen the benefit. At least not yet.

Sløk writes: “The AI cap‑ex boom is currently reflected in sellers’ profit margins, not buyers’. This matters because the S&P 493 companies will take longer to generate returns on investment, increasing downside risk for an economy and market so heavily focused on AI transactions.”

According to Sløk’s data, the Magnificent Seven’s net profit margin is now about 25%, up from roughly 15% at the end of 2023; by comparison, the “other 493 companies” in the S&P 500 have a net margin of about 10%. Over the past three years, the latter group’s margin has remained roughly stable.
Sløk says he ultimately expects profit margins to expand in sectors outside technology and telecom services, “but the speed at which this happens is critical for the market.”

In another report in early July, Sløk wrote that many investors expect AI spending to deliver tangible benefits by 2028. Therefore, the market will need to see so‑called “real results” over the next two years.

Sløk adds: “So many outcomes hinge on a handful of companies; if the payoff is slow, it becomes not just an industry issue but could push the economy into recession and trigger a correction in the S&P 500.”

Major equity indexes are currently at or near historic highs, largely driven by optimistic AI sentiment lifting stocks. Thus, for firms adopting ChatGPT, Anthropic’s Claude and other large language models, the key is proving to investors that their AI outlays will have a clear, positive impact on earnings.

MFS Investment Management global investment strategist Rob Almeida says, “This rally depends on whether AI can be commercialized at the speed the market expects.” He adds that, given the bull market of recent years, “investors need to stay cautious and thoughtful, but they usually don’t,” and that “a lot of retail capital is in a risk‑on mode.”

This is not to say AI is a bubble about to burst. Yet companies in non‑tech sectors such as retail, financial services and healthcare may need more time before they truly reap returns from AI spending.
Based on that, Franklin Equity Group portfolio manager Jonathan Curtis suggests investors might focus mainly on firms that help “run AI,” namely the ultra‑large cloud service providers.
Curtis says, “You’re starting to see investors comfortably return to the ‘Magnificent Seven’ as a safe haven.”

The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF, which holds Nvidia, Apple (AAPL-US), Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US), Amazon (AMZN-US), Meta Platforms (META-US) and Tesla (TSLA-US), has risen nearly 5% since August this year. The renewed trading vigor in mega‑cap tech stocks has also pushed the S&P 500 up about 3.5% so far this month.

For now that’s fine, as investors cheer the strong earnings reports from the tech sector. But AI spending must produce real outcomes—especially as the S&P 500’s price‑to‑earnings ratio is currently about 22 times this year’s estimated earnings.

If all those firms writing huge AI checks to ultra‑large cloud providers do not see their profit margins start to improve materially, it will become increasingly hard to rationalize further broad‑market gains.

items.title: 美銀喊輝達「首選股」！目標價350美元 Rubin時代毛利率長期仍守73%-74%
paras: 輝達 (NVIDIA, NVDA-US) 即將迎來下一代 AI 晶片架構 Rubin 時代，華爾街投行美國銀行 (Bank of America, BAC-US) 看好新平台可能啟動新一輪多季升級周期，將輝達列為「首選股」並給予 350 美元目標價。以當時 223.96 美元股價計算，意味潛在上漲空間達 56.3%。
美銀分析師 Vivek Arya 在最新報告中指出，市場目前對輝達的關注逐漸從 AI 需求能否持續，轉向記憶體成本、毛利率壓力、客製化晶片競爭，以及輝達向 AI 客戶投入資本等風險，但投資人可能低估 Rubin 架構、Vera CPU 及持續增加的雲端資本支出所帶來的下一階段成長機會。
輝達預計 8 月 26 日公布第二財季業績。美銀預估，輝達第二財季營收將達 940 億至 950 億美元，高於公司先前約 910 億美元的指引約 30 億至 40 億美元；該行同時預期第三財季營收指引將達 1070 億至 1080 億美元，高於市場約 1040 億美元的普遍預期。
這意味著，如果美銀預測成真，輝達不僅可能在第二財季再次交出高於自身指引的業績，第三財季展望也可能高於市場預期，進一步強化市場對 AI 資料中心投資周期仍在延續的信心。
輝達此前公布的財報已顯示 AI 資料中心需求仍然強勁。公司 2026 會計年度第 4 季營收達 681.27 億美元，年增 73%, 資料中心營收則達 623 億美元，季增 22%、年增 75%; 全年度資料中心營收達 1937 億美元，年增 68%。公司當時預估 2027 會計年度第 1 季營收 780 億美元, 上下浮動 2%, GAAP 毛利率約 74.9%。

在產品布局方面，Rubin 將成為輝達下一個重要成長支柱。輝達此前已正式公布 Vera Rubin 平台，平台由 6 款新晶片組成，目標是相較 Blackwell 平台最高降低 10 倍推理 token 成本，並預計由亞馬遜雲端服務 (Amazon Web Services, AMZN-US)、Google Cloud、微軟(Microsoft, MSFT-US)Azure 及甲骨文(Oracle, ORCL-US) 等雲端服務商率先部署 Vera Rubin 系統。
美銀認為，Rubin 出貨啟動、新款 Vera CPU 開始放量，以及雲端服務商持續增加資本支出，可能共同觸發一個「多季度升級周期」。因此，Rubin 的重要性可能不只體現在即將公布的單季財報，而在於它能否支撐輝達未來數季的營收及獲利預期持續上修。
這也讓市場開始重新評估輝達下一代系統的單套價值。美銀估算，Vera Rubin NVL 機架價格可能達 700 萬至 850 萬美元，明顯高於 Blackwell Ultra 約 400 萬美元的估算價格。
系統價格提高意味著，即使記憶體、先進封裝及其他零組件成本同步上升，輝達仍可能透過更高的整機售價吸收部分成本壓力。換言之，Rubin 不只是單純提高運算效能，也可能提高每套 AI 系統所能產生的營收。
記憶體成本正是目前市場最關注的風險之一。AI 伺服器對 HBM 等高頻寬記憶體的需求快速增加，導致記憶體供應持續緊張，市場擔憂記憶體價格上升可能侵蝕輝達毛利率。
不過，美銀估計，較高記憶體成本對 Rubin 運算機架毛利率的負面影響約為 60 個基點，幅度低於部分投資人原先擔憂。該行仍預期輝達長期毛利率可維持在 73% 至 74% 左右，略低於目前約 75% 的水準。
美銀認為，輝達具備強大的定價能力、優先取得記憶體供應的能力，以及根據零組件成本變化調整產品價格的空間，因此記憶體價格上升未必會完全轉化為毛利率壓力。
近期市場對記憶體供應的擔憂確實正在升高。市場分析指出，HBM4 及 HBM4E 供應趨緊，價格漲幅可能高於先前預期，而輝達 Rubin 系列對高頻寬記憶體的需求，將進一步成為整個 AI 供應鏈的重要變數。美光科技 (Micron Technology, MU-US)、SK 海力士及三星電子等主要記憶體供應商，也因此成為 AI 資本支出周期的重要受惠者。
但對輝達而言，市場真正關心的可能不是記憶體本身漲多少，而是 GPU 及整套 AI 系統究竟能否將成本轉嫁給客戶。
美銀提供的一項重要觀察是，A100、H100 及 B200 等輝達 GPU 的租賃價格截至 8 月仍接近歷史高點。這顯示雲端服務商及 AI 企業對高階運算能力的需求仍然強勁，也意味著客戶目前仍願意為稀缺的輝達算力支付高價。
如果 GPU 租賃價格及 AI 運算服務收入維持高檔，輝達就可能擁有足夠定價空間，將記憶體及其他零組件成本上升轉嫁給客戶。這將成為 Rubin 時代維持高毛利率的重要因素。
此外，輝達目前面臨的另一項風險是客製化 AI 晶片。包括大型雲端服務商自行開發 ASIC 在內的客製化晶片，正逐漸成為 AI 加速器市場的重要競爭力量。市場擔心，如果超大規模雲端業者提高自研晶片比例，可能降低對通用 GPU 的依賴。
然而，輝達試圖透過 GPU、CPU、網路設備、NVLink、CUDA 軟體及完整 AI 資料中心平台建立更深的生態系統，以降低單一晶片被替代的風險。
輝達目前的競爭優勢也不再只建立在 GPU 效能。隨著 AI 推理需求快速增加，客戶需要的不只是單顆 GPU, 而是能夠把數千甚至數萬顆處理器、記憶體、網路設備及軟體整合在一起的完整運算系統。
輝達先前公布的 Rubin 平台正是朝這一方向發展。公司表示，Rubin 將進一步降低 AI 推理成本，並針對代理型 AI 等新興工作負載提高運算效率。輝達執行長黃仁勳此前也指出，AI 代理正在推動運算需求出現新的轉折，企業對 AI 運算基礎建設的投資仍在快速增加。
在估值方面，美銀認為輝達目前股價提供了另一項看多理由。該行估計，輝達遠期本益比約 16 倍，是近 10 年來相對便宜的估值水準之一。
更重要的是，美銀預期輝達每股盈餘將由 2026 曆年的 4.55 美元增加至 2027 年的 9.09 美元，意味著一年內接近翻倍。
這種「獲利快速成長、估值倍數反而壓縮」的組合，正是美銀維持看多輝達的主要原因。換言之，市場目前給予輝達的估值並沒有完全反映該行預期的獲利增長速度。
美銀因此認為，Rubin 不應被視為單純的新產品發布，而可能成為推動市場重新評估輝達獲利能力及合理估值的催化劑。
不過，輝達未來仍需面對多項風險，包括 AI 資本支出是否能維持目前速度、超大規模雲端業者是否提高 ASIC 採用比例、記憶體及其他零組件成本是否持續攀升，以及 AI 模型效率提升是否降低單位運算需求。
此外，AI 資料中心資本支出已達到極高規模，市場也開始關注大型科技公司投入數千億美元建設 AI 基礎設施後，最終能否產生足夠的投資報酬。如果 AI 服務營收增長速度不及基礎設施投資，雲端服務商未來可能放慢資本支出，進而影響輝達 GPU 需求。
因此，8 月 26 日的財報不只是一次季度業績檢驗，也可能成為市場觀察 Rubin 周期是否正式啟動的重要窗口。若輝達公布的營收及展望高於市場預期，同時確認 Rubin 出貨及供應鏈進度順利，市場可能進一步上修 2027 年及之後的獲利預期。
反之，如果記憶體成本、毛利率、客製化晶片競爭或 AI 資本支出出現明顯壓力，即使輝達當季業績亮眼，投資人仍可能開始擔憂 AI 超級周期的邊際成長正在放緩。
目前市場對輝達的核心問題已從「AI 需求是否存在」逐漸轉變為「AI 需求能否持續以足夠高的價格變現」。在美銀看來，Rubin、Vera CPU 及持續增加的雲端資本支出，可能讓輝達進入另一個多季度的業績上修周期，而 16 倍左右的遠期本益比則提供一定的估值緩衝。
如果這一判斷成真，Rubin 時代可能不只是輝達下一代產品周期，更可能成為市場重新評估其長期獲利能力及估值中樞的關鍵轉折點。

items.title: 馬斯克狂擴SpaceX AI算力 分析師：微軟可能成最大買家
items.title_en: Musk's Ambitious AI Plan for SpaceX May Make Microsoft Its Largest Customer
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 對 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 雄心勃勃的 AI 計畫值得認真看待。分析師指出，這項計畫甚至可能讓微軟 (MSFT-US) 成為 SpaceX 運算能力的主要買家。
SpaceX 上市後首次召開的財報電話會議中，馬斯克展現了宏大企圖。保守來說，他提出 SpaceX 明年將把目前約 1.4GW 的 AI 運算能力，大幅增加約 6GW 至 8GW，甚至可能突破 10GW。
這項計畫可能帶來的一個結果：目前正面臨今年及明年龐大運算能力缺口的微軟，可能成為 SpaceX 運算能力的主要承購方。微軟目前正努力提供 OpenAI 最先進 AI 模型所需的運算資源。
這是 SemiAnalysis 研究團隊的看法，這是一家位於舊金山、獨立經營的研究與顧問機構。
該團隊上周五在 Substack 發布的文章中，深入分析馬斯克這些「再次震撼全球」的雄心勃勃計畫。由 Jeremie Eliahou Ontiveros、Reyk Knuhtsen 及 Jordan Nanos 組成的研究團隊認為，這些計畫其實具有可行性。
如果要將 AI 運算能力提升至 10GW，SpaceX 到 2027 年底前需要投入約 3,000 億至 5,000 億美元的資本支出。但 SemiAnalysis 認為，馬斯克有辦法避開一般資料中心建設所面臨的限制。而 SemiAnalysis 所稱的「大規模、短期內可取得的運算能力」目前極為稀缺，因此市場願意支付相當高的溢價，價格可能達到每 GW 每年約 500 億美元。
這聽起來是非常龐大的金額，而事實上確實如此。但像 OpenAI 及 Anthropic 這類最先進的 AI 公司，仍有能力從中獲得「相當可觀的收益」。究竟有多高？SemiAnalysis 利用自有的推論模擬器及程式設計基準測試進行分析後，估計每 GW 運算能力每年可產生約 1,000 億美元的經常性營收。
除了 OpenAI 及 Anthropic 外，SemiAnalysis 還點名另一家有能力創造如此驚人經濟效益的企業：微軟。Ontiveros 及其團隊認為，微軟能夠取得與這兩家成熟業者相同的營收及利潤率，但不必承擔同等規模的訓練成本，因微軟持有 OpenAI 27% 的股權，以及雙方已談妥的合作協議。
SemiAnalysis 寫道，「簡單來說，微軟有巨大的誘因，盡可能快速取得更多 MW 的運算能力。這可能帶來的影響是，微軟 Azure 的營收成長率可能從目前約 42%，在 2027 年加速至超過 100%。」對 Ontiveros 而言，這代表「一個世代僅有一次的機會，而 SpaceX 正處於最有利的位置，有望去承接」。
SemiAnalysis 坦承，這些數字及預測聽起來「瘋狂」，但研究團隊強調，他們認為這些目標可以達成，主要有兩個原因。
首先，微軟已在為一場規模空前的資料中心擴建潮做準備。公司已簽署大量相關協議，並預期還會簽下更多合約。SemiAnalysis 指出，由於相關合約採取 90 天取消政策，因此「資產負債表風險為零」。
其次，報告認為，整個計畫中較棘手的一環——SpaceX 如何籌措龐大的資本支出——也有機會透過輝達 (NVDA-US) 提供的供應商融資獲得解決，或提前 3 至 5 個月出售大規模運算能力。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that Elon Musk's ambitious AI plan for SpaceX (SPCX-US) is worth taking seriously. Analysts point out that this plan may even make Microsoft (MSFT-US) the primary buyer of SpaceX's computing power.

At SpaceX's first earnings call after going public, Musk presented a grand vision. Conservatively, he said that SpaceX will increase its current AI computing power of around 1.4 GW by 6 GW to 8 GW next year, and possibly even break through 10 GW.

One possible outcome of this plan: Microsoft, which is currently facing a massive computing power shortage this year and next, may become the primary buyer of SpaceX's computing power. Microsoft is currently working to provide the computing resources needed for OpenAI's advanced AI models.
This is the view of SemiAnalysis, a research and advisory firm based in San Francisco.

The team, led by Jeremie Eliahou Ontiveros, Reyk Knuhtsen, and Jordan Nanos, published an article on Substack last Friday, in which they deeply analyzed Musk's 'shocking' plans. They believe that these plans are feasible.

If SpaceX wants to increase its AI computing power to 10 GW, it will need to invest around $300 billion to $500 billion in capital expenditures by the end of 2027. However, SemiAnalysis believes that Musk can avoid the limitations faced by general data center construction. According to SemiAnalysis, 'large-scale, short-term computing power' is extremely scarce in the market, and companies are willing to pay a premium for it, with a price of around $500 billion per GW per year.

This sounds like a massive amount, and it is. However, companies like OpenAI and Anthropic, which are at the forefront of AI development, can still generate 'significant revenue' from this. How much? SemiAnalysis estimates that each GW of computing power can generate around $100 billion in annual recurring revenue.

In addition to OpenAI and Anthropic, SemiAnalysis also named another company that can create such impressive economic benefits: Microsoft. Ontiveros and his team believe that Microsoft can achieve the same revenue and profit margins as these two mature companies, but without the same level of training costs, as Microsoft owns 27% of OpenAI and has a cooperation agreement with it.

SemiAnalysis wrote, 'In short, Microsoft has a huge incentive to acquire as much MW of computing power as possible as quickly as possible. This could lead to Microsoft Azure's revenue growth rate accelerating from around 42% to over 100% in 2027.' For Ontiveros, this represents 'a once-in-a-generation opportunity,' and SpaceX is in the best position to take it on.
SemiAnalysis admits that these numbers and predictions sound 'crazy,' but the research team emphasizes that they believe these goals can be achieved, mainly for two reasons.

Firstly, Microsoft has been preparing for a massive data center expansion wave. The company has signed many contracts and expects to sign more. SemiAnalysis points out that, due to the 90-day cancellation policy of these contracts, 'there is zero asset-liability risk.'

Secondly, the report believes that the most challenging part of the plan - how SpaceX will finance its massive capital expenditures - may be solved through supplier financing provided by NVIDIA (NVDA-US) or by selling large-scale computing power 3 to 5 months ahead of schedule.

items.title: AI退潮銀行變香！MSCI亞太金融指數7月飆8.6%創史上單月最佳表現 亞洲銀行股迎來重估
items.title_en: Asian Banks Surge as MSCI Asia Financials Index Rises 8.6% in July, Best Monthly Performance on Record
paras: 最新數據顯示，亞洲銀行股在 AI 交易波動加劇、部位過度擁擠之際，正迎來數十年來最強的一波防禦性重估。
MSCI 亞太金融指數上月大漲 8.6%，相較於 IT 指數創下史上單月最佳表現。香港金融股指寫下近四年最佳月度表現，日本東證銀行股指數年內漲超 40%、達東證指數整體漲幅兩倍，標普 500 金融族群亦多次刷新歷史高點，亞洲與華爾街形成罕見共振。
資金切換邏輯很清楚：避開 AI 高貝塔、轉進高股息、獲利穩、與本地經濟綁定的銀行保險族群。
美銀亞太股票策略主管 Winnie Wu 表示，仍看好亞洲金融股，未來回報愈發依賴資本回報與獲利成長，繼續加碼日、韓、香港國際銀行及 H 股國有大行。
日本則是極端樣本。日本央行 (BOJ) 結束負利率後緩步升息至 1%，淨利差由壓縮轉至擴張，每升息 1 碼，年淨利息收入增 1800 億日元。近日，三菱日聯 (MUFG) 市值衝上 42 兆日元，超越豐田與鎧俠登頂日股。
摩根大通分析師 Matthew See 出具研究報告指出，BOJ 升息慢但落後形勢，週期具持續性，策略上維持繼續做多。
其他亞洲銀行股方面，滙豐、中銀香港今年來各自漲逾 25%，摩根士丹利看好今年下半年獲利動能與估值重估雙驅；新加坡星展、華僑股價受財管榮景帶動齊創新高；印度民營銀行信貸增速重啟、手續費回升，東春投資 Yuan Yiu Tsai 稱「基本面上行空間更大」而加碼。
MSCI 亞洲金融相對亞太大盤的超額表現，已攀升至 1998 年 10 月 (亞洲金融危機後日本救銀行) 以來最強。
但市場上也不是沒有阻力。AI 股回檔後估值誘人、美國就業轉弱壓低緊縮預期，都可能分流資金，但在 AI 敘事未重新凝聚前，穩健資產品質、穩定手續費與財管收入，讓銀行股仍是配置荒中的錨。
總體來看，目前市場賣掉的是「想象空間」，買進的是「利差 + 回購 + 股息」的確定性，這場防禦股重估還沒到尾聲。
paras_en: Asian banks are experiencing a strong defensive revaluation, with the latest data showing a surge in the sector's stock prices amidst the intensifying AI trading volatility and overcrowding.

The MSCI Asia Financials Index rose 8.6% in July, outperforming the IT index and setting a new record for the best monthly performance. The Hong Kong Financial Stock Index recorded its best monthly performance in nearly four years, while the Japanese TOPIX bank index rose over 40% year-to-date, more than doubling the overall TOPIX index gain. The S&P 500 financial sector also repeatedly broke historical highs, creating a rare resonance between Asia and Wall Street.
The capital rotation logic is clear: avoiding high-beta AI stocks, switching to high-dividend, stable-profit, and locally tied banking and insurance groups.

Winnie Wu, head of Asia-Pacific equities at Bank of America, remains bullish on Asian financial stocks, with future returns increasingly dependent on capital returns and earnings growth. She continues to add to her positions in Japanese, Korean, Hong Kong international banks, and H-share state-owned banks.

Japan is an extreme case. After the Bank of Japan (BOJ) ended negative interest rates and gradually raised interest rates to 1%, the net interest margin expanded, with each 1% interest rate hike increasing net interest income by 180 billion yen. Recently, Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) saw its market value surge to 42 trillion yen, surpassing Toyota and Honda to become the largest stock in Japan.

Morgan Stanley analyst Matthew See published a research report stating that the BOJ's slow interest rate hike is behind the curve, with a persistent cyclical pattern. Strategically, he maintains a continued overweight position.

Other Asian banks, including HSBC and Standard Chartered, have risen over 25% this year, with Morgan Stanley expecting strong earnings momentum and revaluation in the second half of the year. Singapore's DBS and OCBC have also reached new highs, driven by the favorable regulatory environment. Indian private banks have seen a resurgence in credit growth and fee income, with Eastspring Investments' Yuan Yiu Tsai saying that the fundamentals are more supportive and adding to his positions.

The MSCI Asia Financials Index's outperformance relative to the broader Asia-Pacific market has reached its strongest level since October 1998, following the Asian financial crisis and Japan's bank rescue.

However, there are also challenges in the market. The AI stock correction has made valuations more attractive, while a weakening US labor market has lowered expectations for interest rate hikes, potentially diverting capital. But before the AI narrative reconsolidates, stable products, low fees, and stable income from financial services make bank stocks a safe haven in a crowded market.
In summary, the market is selling 'imagination space' and buying 'net interest income + buybacks + dividends' certainty. This defensive stock revaluation is far from over.

items.title: 最高領袖病危？伊朗總統：與穆吉塔巴談七小時
items.title_en: Iran President: Met with Supreme Leader for 7 Hours, Health 'Good'
paras: 伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚 10 日（周一）表示，他剛和最高領袖穆吉塔巴．哈米尼（Mojtaba Khamenei）舉行會談，穆吉塔巴的「身體狀況良好」。
佩澤希齊揚在接受伊朗國家電視台 IRIB 採訪時提出上述言論。他表示，在最近一次持續七小時的會議上，穆吉塔巴持續傳遞「團結與凝聚」的訊息。
佩澤希齊揚稱，會議「非常好」，並列舉了民生、就業、住宅等最重要議題。他說道：「我們也討論了制裁帶來的問題。」
談及穆吉塔巴的身體狀況，佩澤希齊揚表示：「就健康而言，他完全健康。」他說，能夠連續七、八個小時坐著討論複雜問題的人，「不可能有任何健康問題」。
另據伊朗塔斯尼姆通訊社報導，穆吉塔巴當天頒布法令，任命六名高階指揮官，其中阿里 · 阿卜杜拉希擔任武裝部隊總參謀長，基約馬爾斯 · 海達里出任武裝部隊副總參謀長。
據塔斯尼姆通訊社 9 日報導，佩澤希齊揚在總統任期第三年開始之際，見了穆吉塔巴，二人舉行了交談。
上周多家以色列媒體援引伊朗反對派媒體 IranWire 的報導，稱穆吉塔巴病情危重，已被緊急送往醫院。
消息人士透露，「伊朗政府高層流言四起，說穆吉塔巴病情危急，隨時會死掉」，以及「如果我們很快得知他殉道的消息，也不會感到驚訝」。
paras_en: Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi said on Monday that he had met with Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei for seven hours, and that Khamenei's 'health is good'.
Raisi made the comments during an interview with Iranian state television IRIB, saying that Khamenei had continued to convey messages of 'unity and cohesion' during their recent meeting.

Raisi described the meeting as 'very good', and said that they had discussed important issues such as living standards, employment, and housing. He also mentioned that they had talked about the problems caused by sanctions.

When asked about Khamenei's health, Raisi said that 'from a health perspective, he is completely healthy'. He added that someone who can sit for seven or eight hours discussing complex issues 'cannot have any health problems'.

According to the Tasnim News Agency, Khamenei issued an order on Monday appointing six high-ranking officials, including Ali Abdollahi as the chief of staff of the armed forces, and Ghasem Hosseinipour as the deputy chief of staff.
Tasnim reported on Sunday that Raisi had met with Khamenei at the start of his third year in office, and that they had held talks.
Last week, several Israeli media outlets cited reports from the Iranian opposition website IranWire that Khamenei's health was in a critical condition and that he had been rushed to the hospital.

Sources close to the Iranian government have revealed that there have been rumors circulating that Khamenei's health is in a critical condition and that he could die at any moment, and that if such news were to be confirmed, it would not come as a surprise.

items.title: 郭明錤：蘋果今年硬體出貨量確因記憶體短缺而下調
items.title_en: Guo Ming-chi: Apple's Hardware Shipments Were Reduced This Year Due to Memory Shortage
paras: 追蹤蘋果 (AAPL-US) 供應鏈多年的天風國際證券分析師郭明錤 11 日（周二）發布的產業調查顯示，蘋果今年的硬體出貨量確實因記憶體短缺而下調，但蘋果在台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 的處理器訂單，會在至少約三個月前依可取得的記憶體數量規劃生產，而不是讓台積電提前大量生產半成品。
郭明錤說，這不代表台積電不會提前生產、囤積半成品；但若瓶頸不在台積電，這麼做並無實益，因此，蘋果也沒有太大理由額外付錢要求台積電這樣做。
「記憶體供應緊張是真，但我的理解是，並沒有出現『台積電先囤積 10 億美元半成品，再苦等記憶體到貨封裝』這種戲劇性變化。台積電與蘋果都是全球執行力頂尖的企業，在供應鏈管理上，雙方緊密合作下也很難出現這種戲劇性發展。」
paras_en: Guo Ming-chi, a long-time Apple (AAPL-US) supply chain analyst at Taiwan-based investment firm, Windward Securities, released an industry survey on Tuesday, showing that Apple's hardware shipments this year were indeed reduced due to memory shortages. However, Apple's processor orders with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) (2330-TW) (TSM-US) are planned based on the available memory quantity at least three months in advance, rather than having TSMC produce large quantities of semi-finished products in advance.

Guo Ming-chi stated that this does not mean TSMC will not produce semi-finished products in advance and stockpile them. However, if the bottleneck is not at TSMC, such actions would be of little benefit, and therefore, Apple has no strong reason to ask TSMC to do so at an additional cost.

"Memory supply tension is real, but my understanding is that there has been no dramatic change such as 'TSMC stockpiling $1 billion worth of semi-finished products and waiting for memory to arrive for packaging.' Both TSMC and Apple are top-notch global companies, and it's difficult for them to have such a dramatic development in supply chain management, even with close cooperation."

items.title: HBM王座要易主？三星HBM4良率破80%  瑞銀：2027年41%微超SK海力士登頂
items.title_en: Will the HBM Throne Change Hands? Samsung's HBM4 Yield Tops 80% – UBS: 41% in 2027 Slightly Beats SK Hynix for the Top Spot
paras: 韓媒上週日 (9 日) 披露，南韓三星電子 HBM4 量產良率已在本月初突破 80%「黃金良率」門檻，較原定的年底目標提前約四個月達成。
今年 2 月，三星 HBM4 啟動量產時良率尚不足 60%，僅用半年拉升逾 20 個百分點，缺陷率可控、具備規模獲利基礎，標誌著三星在 HBM 賽道正式吹響翻身號角。
根據 Counterpoint 數據，今年首季 HBM 市占率 SK 海力士以 58% 居首，三星與美光各佔 21%，但三星整體 DRAM 市佔達 39%，HBM 地位明顯落後。
良率躍升後，三星定下階段性目標：今年第三季 HBM4 營收季增 3 倍以上、下半年佔整體 HBM 營收超 60%、年底 HBM 市佔拉近至約 38% 與 DRAM 看齊。
瑞銀 (UBS) 預測，按比特出貨份額計，2026 年 SK 海力士以 48% 穩坐第一，2027 年三星將以 41% 微幅反超海力士的 39%，首度登頂。三星已推進 HBM4E(目標良率 70%、明年上半年發布)與客製化 HBM 佈局，12 層 HBM4E 樣品 5 月出貨。
隨著良率企穩，HBM 競爭從「研發比拚」轉向「產能爭奪」，而今年第四季三星與 SK 海力士的擴產速度，將決定 2027 年王座歸屬。
paras_en: South Korean media disclosed last Sunday (the 9th) that Samsung Electronics' HBM4 mass‑production yield surpassed the 80% “golden yield” threshold at the beginning of this month, achieving the target about four months earlier than the originally planned end‑of‑year deadline.

In February this year, when Samsung launched HBM4 mass production, the yield was still below 60%. It took just six months to lift the yield by more than 20 percentage points, making defect rates controllable and establishing a scale‑profit foundation, marking Samsung’s official turning point in the HBM arena.

According to Counterpoint data, in the first quarter of this year SK Hynix led the HBM market with a 58% share, while Samsung and Micron each held 21%. However, Samsung’s overall DRAM market share is 39%, indicating its HBM position is clearly lagging behind.

After the yield jump, Samsung set a phased goal: in the third quarter of this year HBM4 revenue should grow more than threefold quarter‑over‑quarter, HBM4 should account for over 60% of total HBM revenue in the second half, and by year‑end HBM market share should close to about 38%, matching its DRAM share.

UBS forecasts that based on bit‑shipment share, SK Hynix will firmly hold first place with 48% in 2026, while Samsung will slightly overtake Hynix with 41% versus 39% in 2027, reaching the top for the first time. Samsung is advancing HBM4E (target yield 70%, slated for release in the first half of next year) and custom HBM, with 12‑layer HBM4E samples scheduled for shipment in May.

As yield stabilizes, HBM competition shifts from “R&D battles” to “capacity races,” and the expansion speed of Samsung and SK Hynix in the fourth quarter of this year will determine who claims the throne in 2027.

items.title: 川普反索賠！一句「我也要伊朗賠」讓荷姆茲海峽重開破功 油價飆逾6.8%創一周新高
items.title_en: Trump Backtracks on Compensation, Says 'I Also Want Iran to Pay' as Hormuz Strait Talks Stall
paras: 美伊雙方圍繞著荷姆茲海峽重開的博弈在周一 (10 日) 驟然升溫，美國總統川普在 Truth Social 發文，針對伊朗就過去五個月軍事衝突損失提出的賠償與解除制裁訴求反將一軍：「這是有趣的想法，因為現在我也同樣要求伊朗給予賠償。」
川普還在白宮對媒體表示，美國「百分百控制荷姆茲海峽」、已清除伊朗布設水雷，把美方強硬姿態推到新高度。
這是川普首度公開把「對等賠償」列為談判條件。他要求伊朗為衝突中美方傷亡、「數十萬名」據稱遭鎮壓抗議者家屬、黎巴嫩與加沙等地平民死傷，乃至 2000 年「科爾號」驅逐艦遇襲的 17 名美軍家屬支付賠償，但國際上普遍將後者歸咎於蓋達組織，此舉被分析師視為刻意擴大議題邊界、讓實質協議更難落地。
自今年 2 月美以空襲伊朗後陷入封鎖以來，單日通過荷姆茲船隻從戰前 130–140 艘跌至 8 月初約 8 艘。
伊朗與阿曼近期就「新航線圖」磋商順利，德黑蘭堅持重開前提是美方停火、解制裁、歸還凍結資產並賠償；華府則排除任何讓伊朗對通航收費的安排。
川普反索賠一出，伊朗外長阿拉格齊隨即重申道：「華府持續違反去年 6 月臨時協議前，德黑蘭不啟動與美直接磋商。」
市場則用油價表態。布蘭特 10 月交割期油漲價 4.99% 至每桶 87.72 美元，西德州原油 (WTI)9 月期油亦漲 5.05% 至 82.13 美元，創 7 月 29 日以來單日最大漲幅與一週新高。
與此同時，美國國內政治也讓川普騎虎難下。這場戰爭在美極不受歡迎，11 月期中選舉前農村選民對燃油價格敏感，民主黨眾議員基廷已公開批評「這是投降的開始」。
一邊要結束衝突換通膨退燒，一邊把賠償天價塞進議程，美伊談判立場裂口短期無縮小跡象。
分析人士普遍認為，荷姆茲海峽「重開」已從技術談判退回政治較勁，全球能源市場只能繼續為地緣風險定價。
paras_en: US-Iran talks over the reopening of the Hormuz Strait escalated sharply on Monday (10th) as US President Trump posted on Truth Social, countering Iran's demand for compensation and lifting sanctions over the past five months of military conflict: 'This is an interesting idea, because now I also want Iran to pay.'
Trump also told the media at the White House that the US 'has 100% control of the Hormuz Strait' and has cleared Iranian mines, taking a hardline stance.

This is the first time Trump has publicly made 'reciprocal compensation' a condition of the talks. He demands that Iran pay compensation for US casualties in the conflict, 'tens of thousands' of alleged protesters whose families were suppressed, and civilians killed in Lebanon and Gaza, as well as the 17 US military families who lost loved ones in the 2000 USS Cole bombing, which is widely attributed to Al-Qaeda.
Since the US launched airstrikes on Iran in February, the number of ships passing through the Hormuz Strait has plummeted from 130-140 per day to around 8 in early August.

Iran and Oman have recently made progress in negotiating a 'new shipping route map', with Tehran insisting that the strait must be reopened before talks can begin, while Washington has ruled out any arrangement that would allow Iran to charge tolls.

Trump's reversal on compensation was swiftly followed by Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi, who reiterated that 'Washington has continued to violate the temporary agreement reached in June last year, and Tehran will not initiate direct talks with the US.'

The market has responded with a surge in oil prices. Brent crude for October delivery rose 4.99% to $87.72 per barrel, while West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude for September delivery rose 5.05% to $82.13 per barrel, a one-day record high and a new weekly high since July 29.

Meanwhile, Trump's domestic politics are also putting him in a difficult position. The war is extremely unpopular in the US, and rural voters are sensitive to fuel prices ahead of the November midterm elections, with Democratic Representative Kaptur already publicly criticizing it as 'the beginning of surrender.'

On one hand, the US wants to end the conflict and bring down inflation, while on the other hand, it is pushing for compensation that is 'pricey' in the negotiations, with the US-Iran talks' stance showing no signs of narrowing in the short term.
Analysts believe that the Hormuz Strait 'reopening' has shifted from technical negotiations back to a political standoff, and the global energy market will continue to price in geopolitical risks.

items.title: 美日聯手干預失靈？日元重挫1%重回159 市場警告：沒升息就難止貶
paras: 日元由升轉貶，回吐了半數美國和日本歷史性聯手幹預激發的漲幅。
日元週一 (10 日) 收盤走貶，兌美元下跌 1% 至 159.29 日元，成為當日 G10 貨幣中表現最弱的幣別。此次跌勢抹去日元近期干預行情約一半漲幅，對仍密切關注官方是否進一步出手的交易員而言，這是一個具有重要心理意義的轉折。
State Street 策略師李費里奇（Lee Ferridge）表示，如果沒有新的干預措施，日元將持續走弱。市場似乎對當局沒有採取更多干預措施感到失望。
在月初前後，美日兩國聯手展開了自 1998 年以來首次的聯合買匯阻貶行動，助推日元自近 40 年低點反彈。該貨幣在 7 月下旬曾一度走弱至約 164 日元兌 1 美元，隨後在 8 月初的聯合支撐下飆升至 155 日元的高峰。
在月初前後，美日兩國聯手展開了自 1998 年以來首次的聯合買匯阻貶行動，助推日元自近 40 年低點反彈。該貨幣在 7 月下旬曾一度走弱至約 164 日元兌 1 美元，隨後在 8 月初的聯合支撐下飆升至 155 日元的高峰。
不過，日元此後再度陷入疲弱，市場焦點重新回到影響匯率的基本面因素。美日之間巨大的利差、日本財政前景疑慮，以及地緣政治不確定性，持續對日元形成壓力。儘管東京與華府官員均警告，若有需要將再次採取行動。
高盛集團策略師特里維迪（Kamakshya Trivedi）等人在報告中指出：「我們認為，干預後市場反應相對有限，反映出日元走弱背後仍存在基本面因素。」他們預期，「除非全球環境出現轉變，或政策出現意外調整，日元貶值壓力將隨時間重新浮現。」
這波反轉凸顯出，在推動日元下跌的核心力量大致完好無缺之際，干預措施在扭轉日元整體走勢上仍有其侷限性。這也引發了市場臆測，認為當局可能會再度出手支撐匯率。
部分投資人擔心，由於日本週二適逢假日，市場流動性低於平日，可能創造有利於進一步干預的環境。野村證券策略師後藤裕二郎（Yujiro Goto）等人在報告中表示，市場參與者正密切關注官方表態，「焦點仍將集中於日本與美國當局對匯市干預的立場。」
美國銀行外匯策略師亞歷克斯・柯恩（Alex Cohen）認為，若要推動日元進一步升值，需要更「強力」的干預措施，或日本央行釋出將在 9 月升息的訊號。
彭博市場策略師布蘭登・費根（Brendan Fagan）認為，日元干預可以清理槓桿並重新設定匯率，但若沒有實質性的利差收斂，或市場波動大幅升高以降低套利交易吸引力，導致日元走弱的因素仍然存在。
日本央行 7 月底召開利率會議時維持利率不變，但總裁植田和男在會後記者會上釋出偏鷹派訊號，強調物價前景的上行風險增加。該次會議意見摘要也顯示，多名官員指出通膨風險正在升高，其中一名理事更提到，升息速度可能加快。
市場目前預期日本央行 9 月升息機率約為 63%，而 10 月升息幾乎已完全反映在價格中。
Pioneer Investments 策略師帕瑞什・烏帕迪亞（Paresh Upadhyaya）表示：「除非伴隨更強有力的政策行動，否則我對日元大幅升值持懷疑態度。9 月升息本身並不足以支撐日元走強。」

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元連跌兩周後反彈 日元回吐干預漲幅
paras: 美元周一 (10 日) 自連續兩周跌勢反彈，油價持續走高帶動避險需求，為美元提供支撐。外匯市場參與者同時在消化 7 月就業報告弱於預期後，市場對聯準會 (Fed) 升息預期的快速重新調整，目前將目光轉向本周稍晚公布的重要通膨數據，以進一步尋找利率走向的線索。另一方面，日元兌美元周一貶值近 1%，回吐上月歷史性聯合外匯干預後的部分漲幅。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數 (DXY) 上漲 0.3%，報 99.82。過去兩周累計下跌近 2%。
油價周一上漲近 5%，因伊朗排除與美國直接談判的可能性，並表示只有在華盛頓滿足特定條件後，才可能全面重新開放荷姆茲海峽 (Strait of Hormuz)。此外，伊朗支持的葉門青年運動 (Houthi) 攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯能源基礎設施，也進一步加劇市場對區域石油運輸的擔憂。在此背景下，交易員轉向具避險特性的美元。
伊朗國營媒體報導，議會委員會已批准相關管理框架，其中包括禁止敵對船隻通行的條款。伊朗外交部發言人 Esmaeil Baqaei 周一表示，伊朗與阿曼尚未完成有關海峽管理的聯合聲明，並補充稱，相關計畫將包括監控船隻通行的機制，並應為此取得補償。
伊朗也排除與美國進行直接談判的可能性，聲稱美方違反 6 月達成的臨時和平協議。德黑蘭再次提出全面重新開放荷姆茲海峽的條件，包括結束美國海上封鎖、解除制裁，以及就戰爭造成的損失進行賠償。
川普周一表示，伊朗要求賠償自 2 月底美國與以色列對德黑蘭發動聯合攻擊以來所造成的損失。川普表示，他也將「要求伊朗賠償」，並已指示代表「務必將這點納入未來任何談判之中」。
通膨數據成市場焦點
把目光從中東局勢移開，美元周五下跌 0.4%，因數據顯示，美國非農就業人口 2 月以來首次單月下降，主要受到地方政府教育相關職缺減少的影響。此外，5 月和 6 月的非農就業人口合計遭下修 10.3 萬人。
這份就業報告讓聯準會的政策前景更加複雜。一方面，儘管最新數據表現不佳，整體勞動市場仍穩健。另一方面，由於伊朗戰爭導致油價持續波動，通膨風險大幅升高，而部分聯準會決策官員在 7 月最近一次貨幣政策會議上已明顯傾向升息。
交易員在就業數據公布後，下調了對聯準會 9 月升息的預期。
Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management 投資長 Brent Schutte 表示，「7 月勞動市場報告疲弱的好處是，這可能讓政策制定者有更多空間維持利率不變。過去幾年，我們一再看到聯準會偏重其雙重使命中的就業面向，因此，儘管通膨仍偏高，但在最近兩次勞動市場數據略顯疲弱的情況下，聯準會在進一步升息問題上採取審慎態度，也不令人意外。」
目前市場焦點已轉向本周公布的重要通膨指標，以尋找更多貨幣政策走向的線索。重頭戲將是周三與周四分別公布的 7 月消費者物價指數 (CPI) 及生產者物價指數 (PPI)，接著周五還將公布 7 月零售銷售數據。
日元回吐更多干預後漲幅
日元周一大幅走弱，美元兌日元上漲 0.9%，至 159.26。日元如今已回吐上月歷史性干預後取得的部分漲幅。當時美國與日本進行了 2011 年以來首次聯合買進日元行動。
在干預之前，日元兌美元一度跌至 164，創 40 年來低點。日元持續貶值將對日本高度依賴進口的經濟造成壓力。為支撐日元，日本當局通常會出售美國國債——日本是美國國債最大單一外國持有國——取得所需資金後買進日元。
日本金融市場周二因國定假日休市。
其他主要貨幣方面，歐元兌美元下跌 0.1%，至 1 歐元兌 1.1541 美元。

items.title: 日元干預效果遞減 8月表現為G10貨幣最差 市場靜待日銀下步行動
items.title_en: Yen Intervention Effect Fades, August Performance Worst Among G10 Currencies
paras: 日元匯率在經歷了 7 月的強勁反彈後，8 月份再度陷入疲軟。儘管日本與美國近期聯手進行了自 1998 年以來的首次協同干預，但隨著干預效應消退，日元本月表現遜於所有 G10 成員國。
根據數據顯示，日元兌美元匯率在 8 月已下跌約 0.9%，部分回吐了 7 月份約 3.2% 的漲幅。此前美日當局在日元貶至近 164 的四十年低點後出手，一度將匯率推升至 155 附近，但目前已回落至 158.85。
據分析，日本當局在 7 月 30 日與 31 日分別斥資約 530 億及 340 億美元進行干預，若 7 月 30 日的數據獲得證實，將創下史上最大單日干預紀錄。
高盛與野村證券的分析師指出，日元持續承壓的主因在於美日間巨大的利差、對日本財政支出的擔憂以及地緣政治的不確定性。即使東京與華盛頓官方警告準備再次行動，分析師認為若全球環境或政策未出現重大轉向，日元貶值壓力恐將持續存在。
此外，日本銀行 7 月會議意見摘要顯示，通膨風險正在升溫，甚至有委員提議加速升息。目前換匯市場預期 9 月升息的機率約 63%，而 10 月升息則幾乎被完全定價。
由於目前適逢日本盂蘭盆節假期，市場參與度降低且流動性變薄，交易員正密切警惕當局是否會利用此時機再次出手干預。
paras_en: The yen has weakened in August after a strong rebound in July, despite Japan and the US conducting their first joint intervention since 1998. The intervention effect has worn off, and the yen's performance this month has been the worst among all G10 member countries.

Data shows the yen has fallen about 0.9% against the dollar in August, partly reversing the 3.2% gain in July. The intervention had pushed the exchange rate up to around 155, but it has since fallen back to 158.85. The authorities intervened after the yen hit a 40-year low of nearly 164.

Analysts say Japan intervened on July 30 and 31, spending around $53 billion and $34 billion, respectively. If the July 30 data is confirmed, it would set a record for the largest single-day intervention in history.

Analysts at Goldman Sachs and Nomura Securities say the yen's continued weakness is due to the large interest rate differential between the US and Japan, concerns over Japan's fiscal spending, and geopolitical uncertainty. Even with official warnings from Tokyo and Washington that they are prepared to intervene again, analysts believe that the yen's depreciation pressure will persist unless there is a significant shift in the global environment or policy.

The Bank of Japan's July meeting minutes showed that inflation risks are rising, with some committee members suggesting accelerating interest rate hikes. Market expectations are for a 63% chance of a rate hike in September and almost complete pricing for a rate hike in October.
With the Obon holiday in Japan, market participation is lower and liquidity is thinner, and traders are closely watching whether the authorities will use this opportunity to intervene again.

items.title: 才要升息又得救債市？日銀陷入最尷尬處境
items.title_en: Will Raising Rates Be the Rescue for the Bond Market? BOJ Stuck in Its Most Awkward Spot
paras: 日銀 (日本央行 / BOJ) 似乎正逐步朝提前升息邁進，但高市早苗政府的擴張性財政政策推升日本公債殖利率，也讓央行面臨日益升高的政治壓力。市場憂心，即使日銀調高政策利率，貨幣緊縮效果也可能因政府要求擴大購債、壓低長期利率而遭到抵銷。
隨著政府支出計畫推高殖利率，日銀正陷入一場棘手角力：一方面希望推動貨幣政策正常化，另一方面又必須抵抗要求恢復大規模購債的聲音，而購債恰恰是央行多年來試圖逐步退出的政策。
市場對首相高市早苗擴張性財政議程的疑慮，已推升日本政府公債殖利率，增加這個已開發國家中債務負擔最沉重經濟體的融資成本。日本殖利率上升對美國公債市場造成的外溢效應，也引發華府不滿。

高市政府緊盯殖利率 施壓日銀穩定債市

高市早苗上月承諾加強與市場溝通，以維持投資人對日本財政的信心。日本媒體報導，她在 5 月與日銀總裁植田和男會面時，曾要求央行必要時增加購債，以遏止長期利率上升。
高市早苗的盟友隨後接連表達對殖利率攀升及日銀縮減資產負債表的不安。由高市親自挑選加入政府顧問小組的經濟學家永濱利廣表示，相較於升息等傳統工具，高市政府更加重視貨幣政策的「量化層面」。
同屬再通膨派的經濟產業大臣木內稔，也曾警告日銀縮減資產負債表可能衝擊經濟，並敦促決策者優先維持市場穩定。部分分析師認為，政治壓力可能已影響政策，因為日銀在 6 月升息之際，同時決定自下個會計年度起暫停縮減購債計畫。
前日銀官員愛宕伸康警告，若要求央行在長期利率上升時買進公債，反而可能引發「財政支配」疑慮，使市場懷疑日銀是否仍有能力對抗通膨。高市早苗向來支持已故前首相安倍晉三的「安倍經濟學」，其核心之一便是透過大規模資產購買刺激物價及經濟成長。

殖利率逼近 3% 日銀恐被迫再次進場

對日銀而言，重新擴大購債將與多年來退出超寬鬆政策的努力背道而馳。央行 2024 年終止殖利率曲線控制 (YCC)，並啟動縮減購債計畫，希望恢復因長期大規模干預而失去活力的債券市場。
日銀強調，只有當殖利率以脫離經濟基本面的無序方式上升，並威脅金融穩定時，才會透過緊急操作增加購債。美國財長貝森特對日本政策的關切，可能使高市政府不敢公開反對提前升息，但日銀仍在強化抵禦政治施壓的論述。
日銀上周發布研究報告指出，推升公債殖利率的主要因素是通膨升高，而非央行減少購債。6 月會議紀錄也顯示，政策委員已開始討論日銀資產負債表的最終規模，表明央行儘管面臨壓力，仍希望延續政策正常化。
然而，市場最終仍可能迫使日銀出手。日本 10 年期公債殖利率周一升至 2.805%，逐漸逼近部分分析師視為新一波賣壓觸發點的 3%。
野村證券利率策略師岩下真理表示，若日本國內投資人需求不足導致殖利率急升，日銀可能別無選擇，只能進場干預。這正是央行長期以寬鬆政策主導債券市場，如今必須付出的代價。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) appears to be moving step‑by‑step toward an early rate hike, but the expansionary fiscal policy of Prime Minister Kishida’s government is pushing up Japanese government‑bond yields, adding mounting political pressure on the central bank. The market worries that even if the BOJ raises its policy rate, the tightening effect could be offset by the government’s demand to expand bond purchases and keep long‑term rates low.

As government‑spending plans lift yields, the BOJ finds itself in a tricky tug‑of‑war: on one hand it wants to normalise monetary policy, on the other it must fend off calls to resume large‑scale bond buying – a policy the central bank has been trying to unwind for years.

Market scepticism about Prime Minister Kishida’s expansionary fiscal agenda has already pushed up Japanese sovereign‑bond yields, raising financing costs for the world’s most indebted advanced‑economy. The rise in Japan’s yields also creates spill‑over effects on the U.S. Treasury market, prompting displeasure in Washington.

Kishida’s administration is closely monitoring yields and pressuring the BOJ to stabilise the bond market. Kishida pledged last month to improve communication with markets to maintain investor confidence in Japan’s fiscal stance. Japanese media reported that during a May meeting with BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda, she asked the central bank to increase purchases if necessary to curb the rise in long‑term rates.

Kishida’s allies subsequently voiced concerns about climbing yields and the BOJ’s balance‑sheet reduction. Economist Toshihiro Nagahama, hand‑picked by Kishida for a government advisory panel, said the administration places more emphasis on the “quantitative” side of monetary policy than on traditional tools such as rate hikes.

Economy and Industry Minister Kenji Kawai, also a “re‑inflation” advocate, warned that a BOJ balance‑sheet shrinkage could hurt the economy and urged policymakers to prioritise market stability. Some analysts think political pressure may already be shaping policy, as the BOJ, while raising rates in June, also decided to pause its bond‑purchase tapering from the next fiscal year.

Former BOJ official Nobuyuki Atago warned that demanding the central bank buy government bonds when long‑term rates rise could raise concerns of “fiscal dominance,” causing markets to doubt the BOJ’s ability to fight inflation. Kishida has long supported the late former Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s “Abenomics,” whose core includes massive asset purchases to spur prices and growth.

With yields approaching 3%, the BOJ may be forced to step back into the market. Re‑expanding purchases would run counter to years of effort to unwind ultra‑easy policy. The central bank ended Yield Curve Control in 2024 and began tapering purchases to revive a bond market that had lost vitality after prolonged large‑scale intervention.

The BOJ stresses it would only boost purchases in an emergency if yields rose in a disorderly way detached from economic fundamentals and threatened financial stability. U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen’s concerns about Japan’s policy may keep Kishida’s government from openly opposing an early rate hike, but the BOJ continues to reinforce its narrative of resisting political pressure.

A BOJ research paper released last week said the main driver of higher sovereign yields is rising inflation, not the central bank’s purchase reductions. Minutes from the June meeting also showed policymakers beginning to discuss the final size of the BOJ’s balance sheet, indicating that despite pressure, the bank still aims to continue normalisation.

Nevertheless, the market may ultimately force the BOJ’s hand. Japan’s 10‑year government‑bond yield rose to 2.805% on Monday, edging toward the 3% level that some analysts view as the trigger for a new wave of selling pressure.

Nomura Securities rate strategist Mari Iwashita said that if domestic investor demand falls short and yields spike sharply, the BOJ may have no choice but to intervene. That would be the price the central bank pays for having long‑run the bond market with ultra‑easy policy and now being forced to act.

items.title: 〈台幣〉聯準會升息預期降溫 升值5.7分收32.231元
items.title_en: TWD Rises 5.7 Points to Close at 32.231 as Fed Rate Hike Expectations Cool
paras: 新台幣今 (10) 日維持偏強走勢，全日均處升值，終場收在 32.231 元，升值 5.7 分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值 12.23 億美元，以實質拋補需求為交投主軸。
新台幣今日以 32.26 元、升值 2.8 分開出後，最高來到 32.201 元，全日高低價差僅 6.9 分。
觀察主要亞幣，泰銖升約 0.2%，新台幣收升 0.18%，人民幣微升 0.05%，星元小貶 0.05% 左右，美元指數則小幅反彈 0.1%，而日元則重挫 0.4%，韓元更是重挫超過 0.7%。
元大投顧說明，由於美國 7 月非農就業人口意外減少，聯準會 9 月升息機率驟降，使風險偏好提升，市場關注 9 月 15 日至 16 日聯準會舉行會議；而台股密集聚焦季報和營收數字，個股波動大。
國泰證期研究部也指出，美國 7 月非農減少 2.3 萬人，遠遜預期，且前兩月合計下修 10.3 萬人，在薪資和勞參率同步降溫下，顯示就業動能明顯轉弱，市場因而下修 9 月升息預期，美債殖利率回落。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar maintained its strong momentum today, rising throughout the day and closing at 32.231, up 5.7 points. The total trading value of the Taipei Foreign Exchange Market was $1.223 billion, with actual demand for currency exchange being the main driver of trading.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.26, up 2.8 points, and rose to a high of 32.201 during the day, with a daily high-low price difference of only 6.9 points.

Among major Asian currencies, the Thai baht rose about 0.2%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.18%, the Chinese yuan rose slightly by 0.05%, the Singapore dollar fell about 0.05%, the US dollar index rebounded slightly by 0.1%, while the Japanese yen plummeted 0.4% and the Korean won fell more than 0.7%.

According to Yuanta Investment Consulting, due to the unexpected decrease in US non-farm employment in July, the probability of a Fed rate hike in September plummeted, leading to an increase in risk appetite. The market is now focusing on the Fed meeting on September 15-16, while the Taiwanese stock market is focused on quarterly reports and revenue figures, resulting in large fluctuations in individual stocks.

The research department of Cathay Futures also pointed out that the decrease of 23,000 in US non-farm employment in July was far below expectations, and the total revision for the previous two months was 103,000. With the decline in wages and labor participation rate, the employment momentum has clearly weakened, leading the market to lower its expectations for a September rate hike, causing US bond yields to fall.

items.title: 日本央行釋鷹派信號：通膨風險升溫 升息步伐或快於市場預期
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Signals Hawkish Stance: Inflation Risks Rise, Rate Hikes May Outpace Market Expectations
paras: 根據日本央行公布的 7 月政策會議意見摘要，日銀內部對通膨升溫風險的關注顯著提升。一名委員指出，鑑於核心消費者物價指數 (CPI) 已接近 2% 的目標，且物價上行風險較以往更高，日銀未來的升息步調可能會比市場預期的更快。
在該次會議中，日銀將政策利率維持在 1%，但明確釋放了 9 月可能進一步升息的訊號。
日銀委員呼籲應展現防止通膨向上偏離的決心，並主張採取更靈活的方法，根據海外金融環境的變化討論升息規模，而非固守特定的升息節奏。目前，政策焦點已從「將通膨提升至 2%」轉向「避免通膨進一步向上偏離」。
日元走勢是推動升息預期的關鍵因素。日元兌美元匯率上月跌至 40 年低點，加劇了進口型通膨的疑慮。市場參與者已開始反映提前升息的可能性，隔夜掉期交易顯示，9 月升息的機率約為三分之二，而 10 月前升息的機率則高達 96%。
日銀總裁植田和男在會後記者會中同樣展現鷹派色調，強調價格前景存在較大的上行風險。有委員認為，儘管目前難以精確判定「中性利率」(即既不刺激也不冷卻經濟的利率水準，日銀估計約在 1.1% 至 2.5% 之間)，但由於目前利率仍低於此範圍的下限，日銀有必要持續調升利率，為貨幣政策正常化奠定基礎。
未來，日銀稱將持續密切監控中東局勢、人工智慧 (AI) 需求及匯率變動對日本經濟的影響。
paras_en: According to the summary of the Bank of Japan’s July policy meeting, internal concern about rising inflation risk has increased markedly. One board member noted that, given the core consumer price index (CPI) is close to the 2% target and price‑upside risks are higher than before, the BOJ’s future rate‑hike pace could be faster than market expectations.
At the meeting, the BOJ kept its policy rate at 1% but clearly signaled that a further hike could come in September.

The BOJ member called for a firm resolve to prevent inflation from overshooting and advocated a more flexible approach, discussing the size of any hike in response to changes in the overseas financial environment rather than sticking to a preset rhythm. The policy focus has shifted from “lifting inflation to 2%” to “avoiding further upward deviation of inflation.”

The yen’s movement is a key driver of rate‑hike expectations. The yen fell to a 40‑year low against the dollar last month, heightening concerns about import‑driven inflation. Market participants have begun pricing in the possibility of an early hike; overnight swap markets show about a two‑thirds probability of a September hike and a 96% chance of a hike before October.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda also adopted a hawkish tone at the post‑meeting press conference, stressing that price outlooks carry significant upside risk. One member said that, although it is currently difficult to pinpoint the “neutral rate” (the rate that neither stimulates nor cools the economy, which the BOJ estimates at roughly 1.1%‑2.5%), the present rate is still below the lower bound of that range, so the BOJ needs to keep raising rates to lay the groundwork for monetary‑policy normalization.
Going forward, the BOJ said it will continue to closely monitor the impact of Middle‑East developments, artificial‑intelligence (AI) demand and exchange‑rate movements on the Japanese economy.

items.title: 罕見！美財長貝森特多管齊下力阻長債殖利率攀升 華爾街嗅到政策訊號
items.title_en: Rare Move! US Treasury Secretary Yellen Takes a Multi-Pronged Approach to Curb Long-Term Bond Yield Rise, Wall Street Picks Up Policy Signals
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國財長貝森特正打出一套罕見組合拳，試圖掐住長端美債殖利率繼續急升的趨勢。
過去一週，在 30 年期美債殖利率觸及 19 年高點、10 年期站上 4.6% 區間後，貝森特接連出招，被交易員解讀為「財政部對長端利率感到焦慮」的明確信號。
上月底，美國自 1998 年來首度聯手日本買入日元，表面撐匯市，實則堵住日本為籌美元護盤而拋售美債的缺口。貝森特還提示東京可動用聯儲 SRF 融資機制，降低變賣美債壓力。
第二步是發債指引「微整形」。在上週季度再融資聲明中，美國財政部將長天期附息債發行前瞻由「增加 (increases)」改為「調整 (changes)」，市場普遍視為替未來削減 20 年、30 年期供給留後門。
第三步是輿論戰。貝森特近日頻上電視、發社群，為聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許模糊的通膨溝通策略護航，緩解「政策不透明→期限溢價飆升」的惡性循環。
摩根資產管理投資組合經理 Priya Misra 指出，Fed 與財政部必然擔心長端水位，
Misra 說，「干預日元、力挺華許、暗示減長債供給，都是在告訴市場：他們看見了且不惜用盡工具」，但他指出，年赤字近 2 兆美元、通膨黏性未消，新債供給只增不減，財長影響力有天花板。
對白宮而言，壓低房貸與企業融資成本是直接政治任務。美國財政部發言人未回應置評，但市場已接收到訊號，貝森特不想重演「長債失控」劇本，哪怕只能買到幾十個基點的緩衝。
paras_en: According to the latest reports from abroad, US Treasury Secretary Yellen is playing a rare combination of cards in an attempt to curb the rising trend of long-term US bond yields.

In the past week, after the 30-year US bond yield touched a 19-year high and the 10-year yield rose to the 4.6% range, Yellen has taken a series of measures, which traders interpreted as a clear signal that the Treasury Department is concerned about long-term interest rates.

At the end of last month, the US and Japan jointly purchased yen for the first time since 1998, ostensibly to support the foreign exchange market, but in reality to block Japan's sale of US bonds to defend the dollar. Yellen also hinted that Tokyo could use the liquidity provision mechanism of the Bank of Japan's SRF to reduce the pressure of selling US bonds.

The second step is the 'micro-adjustment' of the debt issuance guidelines. In the quarterly refinancing statement last week, the US Treasury Department changed the outlook for long-term bond issuance from 'increases' to 'changes', which the market widely interpreted as a signal to reduce the supply of 20-year and 30-year bonds in the future.

The third step is the public relations campaign. Yellen has recently appeared on TV and social media to defend the Fed's Chairman Powell's ambiguous communication strategy on inflation, aiming to break the vicious cycle of 'policy opacity -> term premium explosion'.
Priya Misra, investment portfolio manager at Morgan Asset Management, pointed out that the Fed and the Treasury Department must be concerned about the long-term level.

Misra said, 'Intervening in the yen, supporting Powell, and hinting at reducing long-term bond supply, are all telling the market: they see it and are willing to use all tools.' However, he pointed out that with a budget deficit of nearly $2 trillion and sticky inflation, new bond supply only increases, and the Treasury Secretary's influence has a ceiling.

For the White House, lowering mortgage and corporate borrowing costs is a direct political task. The US Treasury Department spokesperson did not respond to a request for comment, but the market has already received the signal that Yellen does not want to repeat the 'long bond out of control' script, even if it's just a few dozen basis points of buffer.
